tools.name: list_salons
tools.description: Use this when someone asks which hair salons they run in HairDora, or a salon's id is needed. Returns up to 100 salons with id, name, currency, default language and last edit time. Not for a salon's address, phone or opening hours.

tools.name: get_salon
tools.description: Use this when someone asks for one salon's opening hours, address, phone, website, timezone or default appointment length. Returns that salon's business settings with up to 14 opening-hour rows, Monday first. Not for free booking slots.

tools.name: get_salon_availability
tools.description: Use this when someone asks when their hair salon has free appointment slots or the next opening. Returns, per day, how many online-booking slots are open plus the first start and last end time, for the next 14 days that have openings (no client or stylist names). Not for making a booking.

tools.name: list_providers
tools.description: Use this when someone asks which stylists or hairdressers work at their salon or can be booked. Returns up to 100 hairdresser display names from the organization that owns the salon (no contact details or schedules). Not for stylists' days off.

tools.name: list_clients
tools.description: Use this when someone asks who their clients are, or needs a client id to look up that person's appointments, payments or quotes. Returns up to 100 clients (20 by default) across all the user's salons, or just one, with id, name, salon and last edit time, in no particular order and without a name se

tools.name: get_client
tools.description: Use this when someone asks about one salon client, such as their preferred language or which salon they belong to. Returns the client's name, salon, language and last edit time. Not for the client's email, phone or booking history.

tools.name: list_appointments
tools.description: Use this when someone asks how many appointments are booked on a day or in a period, how many were canceled or no-shows, or when a client is booked. Returns appointments across all the user's salons, or just one, with id, client and salon ids, times and status for any date window, latest first, up t

tools.name: get_appointment
tools.description: Use this when someone asks what services a specific appointment includes, their prices, or the appointment's status. Returns one appointment's client and salon ids, times, status and up to 50 booked services with prices. Not for finding bookings by date.

tools.name: list_calendar_events
tools.description: Use this when someone asks when their salon is closed or has extra opening hours, or when a stylist or chair is blocked for holidays, vacations, sick days, training or meetings. Returns blocks and extra openings with salon, type, scope, effect, all-day flag and times for all salons unless one is giv

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Use this when someone asks what their salon charges for a cut, colour, blow-dry or other service, or what services it offers. Returns services with id, name, price and salon for all their salons unless one is given, 50 by default and up to 100. Not for what a particular client had done.

tools.name: list_payments
tools.description: Use this when someone asks what payments their salon took, whether a client paid, or how much came in over a period. tools.description: Use this when someone asks about price quotes given to salon clients, such as which are pending, approved or rejected. Returns an overview card with the salon's details, a client count, the next 8 upcoming appointments with time, status and number of services, and up to 12 services with prices (no client names or contact details). tools.name: open_hairdora
tools.description: Use this when someone wants to open HairDora and browse their salons, upcoming appointment previews, service prices and booking availability in an interactive sidebar. Returns up to 100 salons to start from (no client names, contact details or private notes). Not for booking, cancelling or charging

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_clients, get_client · Private data: list_providers, list_payments, show_salon_overview, open_hairdora · Public sink: list_clients, get_client · Destructive: list_salons.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_clients, get_client · Private data: list_providers, list_payments, show_salon_overview, open_hairdora · Public sink: list_clients, get_client · Destructive: list_salons

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
